title: LuckyCookie
description: This mod makes stone drop an extra cookie occasionally.
body:
With a chance of 1 to 1000, you will a get a cookie if you mine a stone block. It's not much but it is honest mod. Now also with 30+ unique messages, where you get a random one each time you mine a cookie to keep it fresh.

Hi, I am Bat, this is my fifth mod. I hope you like it. ^^
